t: The Twilight Zone: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
st: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
d: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.

t: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
st: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
d: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately, they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

t: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
st: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
d: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?

t: The Twilight Zone: A Nice Place to Visit
d: After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.

t: The Twilight Zone: And When the Sky Was Opened
st: And When the Sky Was Opened
d: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…

t: The Twilight Zone: Once Upon a Time
d: Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.

t: The Twilight Zone: One for the Angels
d: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

t: Scream 4
d: För tio år sedan förföljdes Sidney Prescott och hennes vänner av den sadistiske och överintelligente seriemördaren Ghostface. När en ung student hittas mördad står det klart att HAN är tillbaka. Och den här gången har spelets regler ändrats.

t: Stephen King's Sometimes They Come Back
d: A high school teacher (Tim Matheson) faces the demon ghosts of a gang of former students. Brooke Adams, Robert Hy Gorman, Robert Rusler, Nicholas Sadler, and William Sanderson also star. Based on a short story by Stephen King.

t: Shriek If You Know What I Did Last Friday the 13th
d: En reporter (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) undersöker en serie mord kallade \\"the Spring Break Massacre\\", vilket leder till ytterligare kaos i denna parodi på slashergenren.

t: After the Lethargy
d: Journalisten Sara reser till en plats där det sägs finnas utomjordingar. Hon och hennes guide attackeras och tvingas söka skydd i en övergiven militäranläggning djupt inne i urskogen.

t: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own
d: A playwright makes characters come to life.

t: The Twilight Zone: To Serve Man
d: The Kanamits, 9-foot tall aliens, arrive on Earth with one lofty goal: To Serve Man.

t: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile
d: Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.

t: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?
d: Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...

t: The Twilight Zone: The Trouble with Templeton
d: A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Silence
d: Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Lateness of the Hour
d: The daughter of an inventor objects to their 'perfect' home where they are waited on by mechanical servants.

t: The Twilight Zone: Static
d: An old radio is taking bitter bachelor Ed Lindsay back to a happier time before what he considers worthless tripe on television when he starts picking up radio programs from the 1930's and 1940's.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street
st: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street
d: Paranoia strikes the residents of Maple Street when they believe human-looking aliens have invaded the neighborhood.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Changing of the Guard
d: An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.

t: The Twilight Zone: Probe 7, Over and Out
d: The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter
d: A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.
